title: keystore_load: decrypted plaintext not mlock'd during CBOR decode
description: In wp11_keystore_load (src/wp11_keystore.c), the plain buffer is allocated with plain malloc before AES-GCM decryption. After decryption, private key DER material sits in an unprotected heap buffer while decode_cbor_payload runs. cbor_read_bytes_alloc inside that decode also mallocs each der_bytes with no mlock. mlock is applied to the entries array and der_bytes only after decode completes. Any page fault during decode can swap the decrypted key material to disk, contradicting the stated threat model. Fix: mlock(plain, plain_len) immediately after malloc, before wc_AesGcmDecrypt; mlock each der_bytes allocation inside cbor_read_bytes_alloc before returning it.
